key_fields.name: CARD-XREF-RECORD
key_fields.meaning: 50-byte card cross-reference record (comment RECLN 50; field sizes add up to 50).

key_fields.name: XREF-CARD-NUM
key_fields.meaning: 16-character card number, primary key of the cross-reference file.

key_fields.name: XREF-CUST-ID
key_fields.meaning: 9-digit customer id owning the card; used by CBSTM03A to read the customer.

key_fields.name: XREF-ACCT-ID
key_fields.meaning: 11-digit account id the card is linked to; CBACT04C reads the file by this field as an alternate key.

purpose: CVACT03Y defines CARD-XREF-RECORD, the 50-byte card cross-reference that links a card number to its customer id and account id. Batch programs use it to resolve a card to its account (CBTRN01C, CBTRN02C), an account to a card (CBACT04C via alternate key), to drive statements (CBSTM03A), to print (CBACT03C) and to migrate (CBEXPORT/CBIMPORT); online programs such as COACTUPC, COACTVWC, COBIL00C, COCRDSLC, COCRDUPC and COTRN02C also copy it.
